description.la: Orationes et meditationes quae sub nomine Anselmi circumferuntur, ordine editionis Gerberonis et Migne: L et ultra orationes, XXI meditationes. Textus ex Patrologia Latina 158 (1853); quaedam genuina, plurima alienis auctoribus adscribenda.
description.en-US: The prayers and meditations that circulate under Anselm’s name, in the order of the Gerberon–Migne edition (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853): the prayers to God, to Christ, to the Cross and to Our Lady and the saints, and the twenty-one meditations. Only a core of them, nineteen prayers and three meditations, is Anselm’s own by the verdict of the critical edition; the rest come from John of Fécamp, Ekbert of Schönau and other writers. Latin only, from a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: As orações e meditações que correm sob o nome de Anselmo, na ordem da edição de Gerberon e Migne: orações a Deus, a Cristo, à Cruz, a Nossa Senhora e aos santos, e as vinte e uma meditações. Só uma parte (dezenove orações e três meditações) é de Anselmo, segundo a edição crítica.

sources.edition: S. Anselmi Cantuariensis archiepiscopi opera omnia, ed. J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 158 (Paris 1853), Orationes (CC text 10630) and Meditationes et orationes (CC text 10626); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), from the Open Greek and Latin machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: Every prayer and meditation as Migne prints them, with Gerberon’s summaries (in italics). The Migne order and numbers are kept; the prayers that are not Anselm’s own are not marked. PL page breaks, columns and variant notes are dropped.
sources.tierEvidence: Anselm died in 1109; Migne’s 1853 printing is public domain everywhere.
